                            <ci>K_vo_trv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_ra</ci>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_ra</ci>
                            <ci>u_rv</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_trv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_trv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_ra</ci>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_puv_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_puv_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_puv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                                <ci>u_par</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_rv</ci>
                            <ci>u_par</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_puv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_puv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                                <ci>u_par</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_la</ci>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_aov</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                                <ci>u_root</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            <ci>u_root</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_aov</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                                <ci>u_root</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
            <!-- The below ensures zeta can't be negative-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>zeta_trv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <max/>
                    <ci>zeta_trv_pre</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>zeta_puv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <max/>
                    <ci>zeta_puv_pre</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>zeta_miv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <max/>
                    <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>zeta_aov</ci>
                <apply>
                    <max/>
                    <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <!-- calculate the flow through the valves-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_trv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_trv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_ra</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_rv</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_trv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_puv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_puv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_rv</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_par</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_puv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_miv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_miv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_la</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_lv</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_miv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_aov</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_aov</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_aov</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_aov</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_root</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_aov</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <!-- Constitutive Relations-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_ra</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_a</ci>
                            <ci>E_ra_A</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>E_ra_B</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>q_ra</ci>
                        <ci>q_ra_us</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_v</ci>
                            <ci>E_rv_A</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>E_rv_B</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>q_rv</ci>
                        <ci>q_rv_us</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_la</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_a</ci>
                            <ci>E_la_A</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>E_la_B</ci>

                        <ci>M_rg_trv</ci>

                                <times/>
                                <ci>M_rg_puv</ci>

                    <apply>
                        <times/>
                        <ci>M_rg_puv</ci>
                        <ci>A_nn_puv</ci>

                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>A_eff_miv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <apply>
                        <times/>
                        <apply>
                            <minus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <ci>M_st_miv</ci>
                                <ci>A_nn_miv</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <ci>M_rg_miv</ci>
                                <ci>A_nn_miv</ci>

                    <apply>
                        <times/>
                        <ci>M_rg_miv</ci>
                        <ci>A_nn_miv</ci>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>A_eff_aov</ci>

                    <plus/>
                    <apply>
                        <times/>
                        <apply>
                            <minus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <ci>M_st_aov</ci>
                                <ci>A_nn_aov</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <ci>M_rg_aov</ci>
                                <ci>A_nn_aov</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>zeta_aov</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <times/>
                        <ci>M_rg_aov</ci>
                        <ci>A_nn_aov</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_trv_pre</ci>

                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_trv_pre</ci>

                            <ci>K_vo_trv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_ra</ci>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>

                            <ci>u_rv</ci>

                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_trv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_trv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_ra</ci>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>

                        </apply>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>

                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_puv_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_puv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                                <ci>u_par</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_rv</ci>
                            <ci>u_par</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_puv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_puv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                                <ci>u_par</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_la</ci>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>

                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_aov</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                                <ci>u_root</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            <ci>u_root</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_aov</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                                <ci>u_root</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
            <!-- The below ensures zeta can't be negative-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>zeta_trv</ci>

                    <max/>

                <eq/>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>zeta_miv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <max/>
                    <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>

                <ci>zeta_aov</ci>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_trv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_trv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_ra</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_rv</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_trv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_puv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_puv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_rv</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_par</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_puv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>

                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>

                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_miv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_miv</ci>

                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_miv</ci>

                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_la</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_lv</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_miv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_aov</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_aov</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_aov</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_aov</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_root</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_aov</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!-- calculate velocities from flow and nominal (constant) area-->
        <variable name="vel_trv" public_interface="out" units="m_per_s"/>
        <variable name="vel_puv" public_interface="out" units="m_per_s"/>

        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>vel_trv</ci>

                    <ci>v_trv</ci>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>vel_puv</ci>

            <apply>
                <eq/>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_ra</ci>

                    <apply>
                        <plus/>

                            <ci>e_a</ci>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_v</ci>
                            <ci>E_rv_A</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>E_rv_B</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>q_rv</ci>
                        <ci>q_rv_us</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_la</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>

                    <apply>
                        <minus/>

                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_v</ci>

                        <ci>E_lv_B</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>q_lv</ci>
                        <ci>q_lv_us</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_ra</ci>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_rv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_la</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_pvn</ci>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_lv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                    <ci>v_aov</ci>

                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                                <ci>u_par</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_la</ci>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_aov</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                                <ci>u_root</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            <ci>u_root</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_aov</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>

                <apply>

                    <bvar>

                    </bvar>

                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_trv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_trv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_ra</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_rv</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_trv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_puv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_puv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_rv</ci>
                        </apply>

                    </apply>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>

                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_miv</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_miv</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_la</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>u_lv</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>L_miv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>v_aov</ci>

                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <plus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <apply>
                                    <minus/>
                                    <ci>B_aov</ci>
                                </apply>
                                <ci>v_aov</ci>
                                <apply>
                                    <abs/>
                                    <ci>v_aov</ci>
                                </apply>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>

                        <ci>u_root</ci>

                    <ci>L_aov</ci>
                </apply>

        </math>
        <!-- calculate velocities from flow and nominal (constant) area-->
        <variable name="vel_trv" public_interface="out" units="m_per_s"/>
        <variable name="vel_puv" public_interface="out" units="m_per_s"/>

                <eq/>

            <apply>

                    <divide/>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>vel_aov</ci>

                    <ci>v_aov</ci>

                </apply>
            </apply>
            <!-- Constitutive Relations-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_ra</ci>

                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>

                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_a</ci>

                        <ci>E_ra_B</ci>
                    </apply>

                        <minus/>

                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_v</ci>
                            <ci>E_rv_A</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>E_rv_B</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>q_rv</ci>
                        <ci>q_rv_us</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_la</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_a</ci>
                            <ci>E_la_A</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>E_la_B</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>q_la</ci>
                        <ci>q_la_us</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>e_v</ci>
                            <ci>E_lv_A</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>E_lv_B</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>q_lv</ci>
                        <ci>q_lv_us</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <!-- Identify LV elastances and scale all others in relation-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>E_rv_A</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>E_lv_A</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0.8</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>E_ra_A</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>E_lv_A</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0.02</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>E_la_A</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>E_lv_A</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0.02</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>E_la_B</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>E_lv_B</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0.9</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>E_ra_B</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>E_lv_B</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0.9</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>E_rv_B</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>E_lv_B</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">0.6</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <!-- Conservation Laws-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_ra</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <ci>v_svc</ci>
                        <ci>v_ivc</ci>

                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_rv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_trv</ci>
                    <ci>v_puv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_la</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_pvn</ci>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_lv</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                    <ci>v_aov</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable name="q_heart" public_interface="out" units="m3"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>q_heart</ci>

                    <plus/>
                    <ci>q_ra</ci>
                    <ci>q_rv</ci>
                    <ci>q_la</ci>
                    <ci>q_lv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>

                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_rv</ci>
                                <ci>u_par</ci>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                </apply>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                                <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>K_vo_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                            </apply>
                        </apply>
                        <apply>
                            <geq/>
                            <ci>u_la</ci>
                            <ci>u_lv</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <apply>
                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>
                            <ci>K_vc_miv</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_la</ci>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>

            <apply>

                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>

                            <ci>K_vo_aov</ci>
                            <apply>
                                <minus/>
                                <ci>u_lv</ci>
                                <ci>u_root</ci>
                            </apply>

                        <apply>
                            <geq/>

                    <otherwise>

                            <times/>
                            <ci>zeta_aov_pre</ci>

                                <minus/>

                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>

                    <apply>
                        <minus/>

                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>

                    <apply>
                        <minus/>

                </apply>
            </apply>
            <!-- Conservation Laws-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>

                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_la</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_pvn</ci>
                    <ci>v_miv</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>

                <apply>

            </apply>
            <!-- R_v = 0.01{second}/C;-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>R_v</ci>
                <cn cellml:units="Js_per_m6">0.0</cn>
            </apply>

                <eq/>
                <ci>v</ci>

                    <apply>

                        <ci>u</ci>
                        <ci>u_d</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>R</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>

            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>

                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_C</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>

                    <ci>v_in</ci>

            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>

                    </bvar>
                    <ci>q_C_d</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v</ci>
                    <ci>v_out_sum</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_C</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <apply>
                        <divide/>
                        <ci>q_C</ci>
                        <apply>
                            <divide/>
                            <ci>C</ci>
                            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">2</cn>
                        </apply>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>u_ext</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_C_d</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <apply>
                        <divide/>
                        <ci>q_C_d</ci>
                        <apply>
                            <divide/>
                            <ci>C</ci>
                            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">2</cn>
                        </apply>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>u_ext</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <ci>u_0</ci>
                    <ci>u_C</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="J_per_m3">2</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <!-- *R_v*(v_in-v);-->
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>u_d</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <ci>u_0</ci>
                    <ci>u_C_d</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="J_per_m3">2</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!-- *R_v*(v-v_out_sum);-->
    </component>

                    <apply>

                        <ci>l</ci>

                            <ci>r_0</ci>

<model name="my_model" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">
    <!--
 Enterocyte cell model 
 -->
    <component name="main">
        <variable name="t" units="second"/>
        <variable initial_value="8.314" name="R" units="J_per_mol_per_K"/>
        <variable initial_value="308" name="T" units="kelvin"/>
        <variable initial_value="0.964853321e5" name="F" units="C_per_mol"/>
        <variable name="RT" units="J_per_mol"/>
        <variable name="RTF" units="J_per_C"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>RT</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>R</ci>
                    <ci>T</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>RTF</ci>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <ci>RT</ci>
                    <ci>F</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!-- area-to-volume ratio-->
        <variable initial_value="1e-3" name="area" units="mm2"/>
        <variable initial_value="2" name="volume" units="pL"/>
        <variable name="Gamma_cell" units="mm2_per_pL"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>Gamma_cell</ci>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <ci>area</ci>
                    <ci>volume</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!--
 ----Balance eqns for whole cell using scaling for protein density ---
-->
        <!-- var Scale_GLUT2base: dim {init: 100};-->
        <variable name="Scale_GLUT2base" units="dim"/>
        <!--        Scale_GLUT2base = 1000{dim}*Scale_GLUT2apex;-->
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>Scale_GLUT2base</ci>
                <cn cellml:units="dim">1000</cn>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable initial_value="0.0186" name="Scale_GLUT2apex" units="dim"/>
        <!--      var Scale_GLUT2apex: dim;-->
        <variable initial_value="1.86" name="Scale_SGLT1" units="dim"/>
        <!--      var Scale_SGLT1: dim;-->
        <variable initial_value="1" name="Scale_NKA" units="dim"/>
        <!--      var Scale_NKA:   dim;  -->
        <variable initial_value="3.35" name="Scale_Kir" units="dim"/>
        <!--      var Scale_Kir:   dim;-->
        <variable name="Glc_Ratio_GLUT2_SGLT1" units="dim"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>Glc_Ratio_GLUT2_SGLT1</ci>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <ci>Scale_GLUT2apex</ci>
                    <ci>Scale_SGLT1</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!--      v_K_tot   = 0 {fmol_per_mm2_per_s};
      v_Na_tot  = 0 {fmol_per_mm2_per_s};
      v_Glc_tot = 0 {fmol_per_mm2_per_s};-->
        <!--
 ----------------- Outward electrical current -------------------

 Units for membrane fluxes are fmol_per_mm2_per_s; F/Cm is C_per_mol/C2_per_J_per_mm2 = J.mm2/(C.mol)
 product of F/Cm x fluxes x 1e-15mol/fmol is (J/C)/s-->
        <variable name="v_e_NKA" units="pA_per_mm2"/>
        <variable name="v_e_SGLT1" units="pA_per_mm2"/>
        <variable name="v_e_Kir" units="pA_per_mm2"/>
        <variable name="v_e_tot" units="pA_per_mm2"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_e_NKA</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>F</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="mol_per_fmol" type="e-notation">1<sep/>-15</cn>
                    <ci>v_NKA</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="pA_per_A" type="e-notation">1<sep/>9</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_e_SGLT1</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>F</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <cn cellml:units="mol_per_fmol" type="e-notation">1<sep/>-15</cn>
                    <cn cellml:units="dim">2</cn>
                    <ci>v_SGLT1</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="pA_per_A" type="e-notation">1<sep/>9</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_e_Kir</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <ci>F</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="mol_per_fmol" type="e-notation">1<sep/>-15</cn>
                    <ci>v_Kir</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="pA_per_A" type="e-notation">1<sep/>9</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_e_tot</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <ci>v_e_NKA</ci>
                    <ci>v_e_SGLT1</ci>
                    <ci>v_e_Kir</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable initial_value="-0.060" name="u_e" units="J_per_C"/>
        <!-- ode(u_e, t) = -0.12{J_per_C_per_s};-->
        <variable initial_value="1e-2" name="C_m" units="C2_per_J_per_mm2"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>u_e</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <divide/>
                        <ci>F</ci>
                        <ci>C_m</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <cn cellml:units="mol_per_fmol" type="e-notation">1<sep/>-15</cn>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <apply>
                            <minus/>
                            <apply>
                                <times/>
                                <cn cellml:units="dim">2</cn>
                                <ci>v_SGLT1</ci>
                            </apply>
                            <ci>v_NKA</ci>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>v_Kir</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!--
 ----------------- Outward potassium flux -------------------
-->
        <variable name="v_K_NKA" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_K_Kir" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_K_tot" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_K_NKA</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <cn cellml:units="dim">2</cn>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>v_NKA</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_K_Kir</ci>
                <ci>v_Kir</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_K_tot</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <ci>v_K_NKA</ci>
                    <ci>v_K_Kir</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!--
 ----------------- Outward sodium flux -------------------
-->
        <variable name="v_Na_NKA" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_Na_SGLT1" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_Na_tot" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Na_NKA</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <cn cellml:units="dim">3</cn>
                    <ci>v_NKA</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Na_SGLT1</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <cn cellml:units="dim">2</cn>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>v_SGLT1</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Na_tot</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <ci>v_Na_NKA</ci>
                    <ci>v_Na_SGLT1</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!--
 ----------------- Outward Glucose flux -------------------
-->
        <variable name="v_Glc_SGLT1" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_Glc_GLUT2base" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_Glc_GLUT2apex" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_Glc_NKA" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <variable name="v_Glc_tot" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Glc_SGLT1</ci>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_SGLT1</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Glc_GLUT2apex</ci>
                <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>v_GLUT2apex</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Glc_GLUT2base</ci>
                <ci>v_GLUT2base</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Glc_NKA</ci>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <ci>v_NKA</ci>
                    <cn cellml:units="dim">2</cn>
                </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>v_Glc_tot</ci>
                <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <ci>v_Glc_SGLT1</ci>
                    <ci>v_Glc_GLUT2apex</ci>
                    <ci>v_Glc_GLUT2base</ci>
                    <ci>v_Glc_NKA</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable name="Glc_Fraction" units="dim"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>Glc_Fraction</ci>
                <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                        <times/>
                        <apply>
                            <minus/>
                            <cn cellml:units="dim">100</cn>
                        </apply>
                        <ci>v_Glc_NKA</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                        <plus/>
                        <ci>v_Glc_SGLT1</ci>
                        <ci>v_Glc_GLUT2apex</ci>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!--
 ------------ Boundary conditions & flux balance eqns -------------

 Note that in the application of ODEs for intracellular qtys, LHS is mM/s or fmol/pL/s; and RHS is mm2/pL x fmol/mm2/s-->
        <!--        var c_Na_gut: mM {init: 140};-->
        <variable initial_value="140" name="c_Na_cap" units="mM"/>
        <variable initial_value="1" name="c_Na_int" units="mM"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>c_Na_int</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>Gamma_cell</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>v_Na_tot</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable initial_value="4.5" name="c_K_cap" units="mM"/>
        <variable initial_value="140" name="c_K_int" units="mM"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>c_K_int</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>Gamma_cell</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>v_K_tot</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable initial_value="5" name="c_Glc_gut" units="mM"/>
        <variable name="c_Na_gut" units="mM"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>c_Na_gut</ci>
                <piecewise>
                    <piece>
                        <cn cellml:units="mM">50</cn>
                        <apply>
                            <lt/>
                            <ci>t</ci>
                            <cn cellml:units="second">500</cn>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <piece>
                        <cn cellml:units="mM">40</cn>
                        <apply>
                            <lt/>
                            <ci>t</ci>
                            <cn cellml:units="second">1000</cn>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <piece>
                        <cn cellml:units="mM">30</cn>
                        <apply>
                            <lt/>
                            <ci>t</ci>
                            <cn cellml:units="second">1500</cn>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <piece>
                        <cn cellml:units="mM">20</cn>
                        <apply>
                            <lt/>
                            <ci>t</ci>
                            <cn cellml:units="second">2000</cn>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <piece>
                        <cn cellml:units="mM">10</cn>
                        <apply>
                            <lt/>
                            <ci>t</ci>
                            <cn cellml:units="second">2500</cn>
                        </apply>
                    </piece>
                    <otherwise>
                        <cn cellml:units="mM">5</cn>
                    </otherwise>
                </piecewise>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <!--        var c_Glc_gut: mM {init: 1};-->
        <variable initial_value="5" name="c_Glc_cap" units="mM"/>
        <variable initial_value="0.1" name="c_Glc_int" units="mM"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <apply>
                    <diff/>
                    <bvar>
                        <ci>t</ci>
                    </bvar>
                    <ci>c_Glc_int</ci>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>Gamma_cell</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>v_Glc_tot</ci>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable initial_value="1" name="c_ATP" units="mM"/>
        <variable initial_value="0.035" name="c_ADP" units="mM"/>
        <variable initial_value="0.8" name="c_Pi" units="mM"/>
        <variable name="c_H" units="mM"/>
        <variable initial_value="7.2" name="pH" units="dim"/>
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
            <apply>
                <eq/>
                <ci>c_H</ci>
                <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <cn cellml:units="mM" type="e-notation">1<sep/>3</cn>
                    <apply>
                        <power/>
                        <cn cellml:units="dim">10</cn>
                        <apply>
                            <minus/>
                            <ci>pH</ci>
                        </apply>
                    </apply>
                </apply>
            </apply>
        </math>
        <variable name="q_Na_gut" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_Na_int" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_Na_cap" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_K_int" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_K_cap" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_ATP" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_ADP" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_Pi" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_H" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_Glc_gut" units="fmol"/>
        <variable name="q_Glc_int" units="fmol"/>
        <variable initial_value="1" name="W_cap" units="pL"/>
        <variable initial_value="1" name="W_int" units="pL"/>
        <variable initial_value="1" name="W_gut" units="pL"/>
    </component>
    <rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#" name="User_Modules">
  <component name="GLUT2">
    <variable name="k_o_GLUT2" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="K_i_GLUT2" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_io_GLUT2" units="mM2" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="kappa_GLUT2" units="pL_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="PHI_GLUT2" units="dimensionless"/>
    <variable name="v_GLUT2_raw" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
    <variable name="v_GLUT2" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="area" units="mm2" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_Glc_o" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_Glc_i" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Scale_GLUT2" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>PHI_GLUT2</ci>
        <apply>
          <plus/>
          <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <ci>c_Glc_o</ci>
            <ci>k_o_GLUT2</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <ci>c_Glc_i</ci>
            <ci>K_i_GLUT2</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci>c_Glc_o</ci>
              <ci>c_Glc_i</ci>
            </apply>
            <ci>k_io_GLUT2</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>v_GLUT2_raw</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <ci>kappa_GLUT2</ci>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci>PHI_GLUT2</ci>
              <ci>area</ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>c_Glc_o</ci>
            <ci>c_Glc_i</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>v_GLUT2</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <ci>v_GLUT2_raw</ci>
          <ci>Scale_GLUT2</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>
  <component name="Kir">
    <variable name="z1_Kir" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="z2_Kir" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="z3_Kir" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="z4_Kir" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="z5_Kir" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="z6_Kir" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="K_int_Kir" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="K_cap_Kir" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="PHI_Kir" units="dimensionless"/>
    <variable name="kappa_Kir" units="pL_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="v_Kir_raw" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s"/>
    <variable name="v_Kir" units="fmol_per_mm2_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="u_rev_Kir" units="J_per_C"/>
    <variable name="RTF" units="J_per_C" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="u_e" units="J_per_C" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="area" units="mm2" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_K_int" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_K_cap" units="mM" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Scale_Kir" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>PHI_Kir</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <apply>
            <exp/>
            <apply>
              <divide/>
              <apply>
                <times/>
                <apply>
                  <minus/>
                  <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <apply>
                      <minus/>
                      <ci>z1_Kir</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>z2_Kir</ci>
                  </apply>
                  <ci>z3_Kir</ci>
                </apply>
                <ci>u_e</ci>
              </apply>
              <ci>RTF</ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci>c_K_int</ci>
                <ci>K_int_Kir</ci>
              </apply>
              <apply>
                <exp/>
                <apply>
                  <divide/>
                  <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                      <minus/>
                      <ci>z1_Kir</ci>
                      <ci>z2_Kir</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>u_e</ci>
                  </apply>
                  <ci>RTF</ci>
                </apply>
              </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci>c_K_cap</ci>
                <ci>K_cap_Kir</ci>
              </apply>
              <apply>
                <exp/>
                <apply>
                  <divide/>
                  <apply>
                    <times/>
                    <apply>
                      <minus/>
                      <ci>z6_Kir</ci>
